design.comparison: Use the original I/Q axis and averaging. Train two Gaussian emissions and a two-state transition matrix on repeat 0 only. Freeze parameters, decode other repeats with Viterbi, and score the same disjoint windows, grouped by the shared start label. Report excluded windows where start labels differ. Compare a Gaussian HMM initialized from the threshold calibration against the refitted Gaussian HMM on held-out observations using predictive log likelihood.
design.boundary: Decoded first exit and endpoint change are model-dependent. Both decoders can misclassify at the available bandwidth. Disjoint windows can still be statistically dependent.
